title: CallChatSyn — Voice & Message Agents for Business
excerpt: One AI agent answers every call and message — FAQ, order status, and appointment booking, handled automatically.
content_html:
Use your business's CallChatSyn answering bot and booking calendar from your own website, app or AI agent. Same answers your customers get on WhatsApp and your booking page. Machine-readable spec: openapi.json.

Founder offer: free for the first 1,000 businesses

Answering bot, order status and bookings through the API on any plan, with no trial expiry (up to 100 API calls a day, 2,000 a month). Building for clients? Each client business claims its own spot.

  1. Create a free account and confirm your email.
  2. Add your FAQs and opening hours (2 minutes).
  3. Open Dashboard → Developers, click Claim founder API access, and create a key.

Try it now, no sign-up

Use the public demo key ccs_demo_public with any example below. It answers as our demo business, and bookings are dry runs: you see the time would be booked, but nothing is saved. It's shared by everyone, so it allows 500 calls a day in total.

curl https://callchatsyn.com/api/v1/answer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ccs_demo_public" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"message": "Where are you located?"}'

1. Get a key

In Dashboard → Developers, create a key. It's shown once; keep it on your server, never in browser code. Send it on every request as Authorization: Bearer ccs_live_….

2. Answer a customer's message

curl https://callchatsyn.com/api/v1/answer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CCS_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"message": "What are your opening hours?"}'

# {"intent":"faq","lang":"en","matched":true,"reply":"We're open every day, 9am to 9pm."}

3. Book an appointment

curl https://callchatsyn.com/api/v1/slots -H "Authorization: Bearer $CCS_KEY"
# {"slots":[{"start":"2026-10-10T02:00:00.000Z","label":"Sat 10 Oct, 10:00"}],"services":["Haircut"],"locations":["Main St"]}

curl https://callchatsyn.com/api/v1/bookings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CCS_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"start":"2026-10-10T02:00:00.000Z","service":"Haircut","name":"Ana","email":"ana@example.com"}'

# 201 {"booked":true,"start":"2026-10-10T02:00:00.000Z","label":"Sat 10 Oct, 10:00"}

Use it from an AI assistant (MCP)

The open-source callchatsyn-mcp server gives Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients three tools: answer a customer question, list open times, book an appointment.

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "callchatsyn": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "github:oneappsworld/callchatsyn-mcp"],
      "env": { "CALLCHATSYN_API_KEY": "ccs_live_..." }
    }
  }
}

Errors and limits

  • Errors look like {"error":{"code":"…","message":"…"}}.
  • With the demo key, POST /api/v1/bookings returns 200 with {"booked":false,"demo":true} instead of booking.
  • 401 bad key · 402 plan inactive · 403 feature not in plan · 429 usage limit · 400/404/409 request problems.
  • Each request counts toward the business's plan limits, the same as WhatsApp and booking-page messages.
  • The answering bot, order status and bookings are included on the Pro plan. Founder offer: the first 1,000 businesses to claim it in Dashboard → Developers get them free on any plan (up to 100 API calls a day, 2,000 a month).
